intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The twenty-eight days are over. There will be no royal wedding this season.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: No clever message, extra training session or well-timed browser refresh can bring the last day back.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A clerk stamps your appeal *RECEIVED*, then stamps a second page *DENIED* without reading the first.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The clerk hands back your journal. Every choice you made is still in it, and it stays yours until you restart or begin a new route.
